coverage.disclaimer: Unsigned. This report records one run of the RowAttest engine against one Supabase project. It states only what the two execution paths observed for the cells listed here, and nothing about surfaces it did not evaluate or about any other data or system. A cell carries an agreed verdict only where the front-door layer and the rollback-simulation layer reached the same outcome; every other cell remains provisional. The report body's "signed: false" flag and the word "Unsigned" in the disclaimer describe the report content itself, whose bytes never change when a signature is attached; the appended Ed25519 signature block is what marks this report as signed.
limitations: This report describes this one run against this one Supabase project, whether a local stack or a hosted one.

Reads, updates and deletes target rows the run created for one test user, the owner. Other test identities attempt them: where the access model has organizations, a second member of the owner's organization and a member of another organization; a signed-in user who belongs to no organization; and an anonymous visitor.
An agreed verdict is recorded only where both layers were determinate and reached the same outcome. A single-layer observation never earns an agreed verdict.

DISAGREEMENT means a contradiction between two determinate layers and blocks a clean report; ERROR means a probe or harness fault and also blocks. Both are engine conditions, not security statements about the tenant.

A storage read cannot be confirmed at the front door (L48): the Storage API answers with the same not_found body for an object hidden by row-level security and for one that is absent, so Layer A records such reads as inconclusive; where Layer B is determinate the cell is corroborated by one layer only and stays provisional.
A storage write is exercised by Layer A only; the rollback-simulation layer cannot faithfully reproduce the upload path as SQL.
A write-probe shape that never produced an allowed outcome anywhere in this run is listed as a probe-validity caveat: its denials have no positive control (L47).
An operation the owner was denied on the owner's own row is listed as a probe-validity caveat: the denials other identities received on that table have no positive control.
A not-evaluated surface was observed but not exercised, and carries no verdict.
Finding tags (CWE, OWASP API Security Top 10 2023) classify the kind of weakness observed; they are not severity claims.

Each table's ownership comes from the access model embedded in this report. A table marked confirmed or declared was described by the customer; RowAttest checked that the columns and keys named exist before testing. A declaration can add tests or change what is expected; it never removes a test.
